children.name: Chlorobium chlorochromatii
children.description: Chlorobium chlorochromatii, formerly known as Chlorobium aggregatum, is a symbiotic green sulfur bacteria that performs anoxygenic photosynthesis and functions as an obligate photoautotroph using reduced sulfur species as electron donors.
